title: Mickey Markle and ragtime piano
summary: They talk about pianists Bill Whitmore and Mickey Markle, the only pianist recorded with the Halfway House band, and Abbie's liking for rags.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Yeah. Pussycat Rag, Barrettaria. Let me call you Sweetheart. I can't remember what was on the back of that. Did you ever know Bill Whitmore? Yeah, piano player. Yeah. Did you ever make any records with him?
I don't think. I played with him but I don't think I ever made any records with him. He wrote a real good tune, that New Orleans Shuffle, do you know that?
No I know of it. I don't know. I may have, I can't be sure of that but I don't recall.
Who was the piano player with Bill? The session with rap. What's called?
Mickey Markle. Mickey Markle. Mickey Markle. Mickey Markle. Mickey Markle. Mickey Markle. Mickey Markle is the only one. He's the only one. Yeah. Did you ever make any records with him?

I played with him. Mickey Markle is the only one outside of this one record of Red Longs where he made his own tune. Mickey Markle is the only one that ever recorded with a Halfway House band. We made a record on that too. We used to play quite a few of those rags. Abbie used to like those rags. They'd play notes you know. He used to like it. He'd take them a month to learn it you know. But once he got it in his noodle he'd never forget it.
